gap: No result ChatGPT got lists today's prices for the whole field side by side: on its own US store on 13 Nov 2026 the UGREEN Nexode 65W 3-Port Travel Charger is $44.98 (marked down from $61.43). That is $15 under Native Union's 67W 3-port ($59.99) and $35 under Twelve South's PlugBug Find My Travel 50W ($79.99). Only KUXIU's 65W UltraSlim is cheaper ($28.99), and it has two USB-C ports and no USB-A.
standout_why: I compared against the cited smartgadgetkit.com UGREEN review, which gives one Amazon US price ($49.99), 340 g and 45 W + 20 W, and names no rival with interchangeable plugs or a price. Android Central (cited) returned only its header to my fetch, so I could not check its list. No result page ChatGPT got puts dated maker-store prices for UGREEN, Native Union, KUXIU, j5create and Twelve South next to each other. ChatGPT's answers quoted some of these prices on cards, but no page in its results states them, and the UGREEN price it quoted was alternately $49.99 and $44.98.
decides: This confirms UGREEN as the pick on price. It is the cheapest model that has two USB-C ports, a USB-A port and US/UK/EU heads, sold by its maker today. Of the models priced here, the one cheaper option with US/UK/EU plugs (KUXIU, $28.99) gives up the USB-A port. Native Union costs $15 more for 2 W extra. j5create costs the same ($44.99) or $5 more with a cable ($49.99). PlugBug costs $35 more for only 50 W, or $85 more for the 120 W version.
